---
title: "check-result-titles.yml"
---

Diff-scoped check that flags a result div whose title is not a sentence.
It fails by default, since agents ignore warnings (Ezra, 2026-11-02).
The title of a theorem, lemma, proposition, corollary, or conjecture div
is a declarative sentence that states the result (Ezra, 2026-11-20).
A result with a customary name may put the name first,
followed by a colon,
as in "Bias-variance decomposition: the expected test error is the variance
plus the squared bias plus the noise".
The rule text is in psw,
"Title a result with the sentence it states".

The check reads the title of each div whose id starts with a prefix in
`prefixes`:
the `title="..."` attribute on its opening fence,
or else the first heading written directly inside it.

A title counts as a sentence when it holds a finite verb,
or when its math holds a relation such as `=`, `<`, `\le`, or `\in`.
The verb test is a word list, not a parser:

- An auxiliary or copula (`is`, `are`, `has`, `does`, `can`, ...) counts.
- A verb from the script's `VERB_STEMS` list counts,
  in its base form or its third-person form
  (`equal`, `equals`, `converges`, `separates`, ...).
- A word that is more often a noun in a title,
  such as `estimate`, `bounds`, `squares`, or `weights`,
  does not count, so "Bounds on the leverage" is flagged.
- The first word of the title never counts.
- Words after `that`, `which`, `when`, `if`, and other clause openers are
  dropped first, so a verb in a relative clause,
  as in "Number of models that best subset selection fits",
  does not count.

So a sentence whose only verb is missing from the list is flagged.
Add the verb to `VERB_STEMS` in a pull request here,
or mark the line with `<!-- check-result-titles: allow: <reason> -->`.

The check does not count
a title inside a code fence, an HTML comment, or the YAML front matter.

Measured on 2026-11-20 over `Morrison-Lab/lds`,
the check read 144 result titles and flagged 76.
Each flagged title read by hand was a noun phrase,
a gerund phrase, or a bare name.

## Scope

A finding is reported only when the title line was added in the pull request,
so existing titles are not swept.
A title line whose exact text the pull request also deletes counts as moved.
With no `base-ref`, or when the diff cannot be computed,
the check skips with a warning instead of scanning the whole tree.
Set `whole-tree: true` to scan every tracked page in full on purpose,
which measures how many titles in a corpus break the rule.

## Inputs

| Input          | Type    | Default    | Description |
| -------------- | ------- | ---------- | ----------- |
| `globs`        | string  | `'*.qmd'`  | Space-separated git pathspecs of tracked files to check (recursive by default). |
| `paths-ignore` | string  | `''`       | Comma- or newline-separated glob patterns (relative paths) to skip. Supports `*`, `?` and recursive `**`. |
| `prefixes`     | string  | `'thm lem prp cor conj'` | Space-separated div id prefixes that mark a result div. |
| `fail`         | boolean | `true`     | Fail the workflow when an added result title is not a sentence. Set `false` for warning annotations only. |
| `whole-tree`   | boolean | `false`    | Scan every tracked page in full instead of only a PR's added lines. |
| `python-version` | string | `'3.x'`   | Python version to set up. |
| `runs-on` | string | empty (`CI_RUNNER` variable, else `ubuntu-latest`) | Runner label for the job. Use a self-hosted label only for a private repository; never for a public one, whose pull requests can run arbitrary code on it ([#1167](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/issues/1167)). |

## Permissions

Only `contents: read` (the default), so no `permissions:` block is needed.

## Example

```yaml
# Copy to .github/workflows/check-result-titles.yml in your repo.
# Diff-scoped check: flags the title of a theorem, lemma, proposition, corollary,
# or conjecture div when a PR adds it and it is not a declarative sentence stating the
# result. A customary name may come first, followed by a colon.
# Fails by default.
# Only contents:read is needed (the default), so no permissions block is required.
name: Check result titles

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  check:
    uses: Morrison-Lab/gha/.github/workflows/check-result-titles.yml@v3
    # with:
    #   globs: '*.qmd'                         # pathspecs to check (recursive)
    #   paths-ignore: 'chapters/outtakes/**'   # skip known-noisy paths
    #   prefixes: 'thm lem prp cor conj'      # div id prefixes of result divs
    #   fail: false                            # warn instead of block (defaults to true)
    #   whole-tree: true                       # scan every page, not just a PR's additions
```

See
[`examples/check-result-titles.yml`](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/blob/main/examples/check-result-titles.yml)
for the full caller stub.
